extension.summary: Play your RomM library with Kodi's built-in emulators
extension.description: Browse the ROM library of a self-hosted RomM server, download games and BIOS files on demand, and play them in Kodi's RetroPlayer using the installed libretro game add-ons.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a RomM server (5.0 or newer) that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the RomM project.
extension.news: v0.2.3 - Offers to install a missing emulator, then starts the game - Install emulator: add more emulators for a platform from the context menu - More emulators and platforms, including the LibreELEC repository cores - Download folder limit is now a share of free disk space v0.2.2 - PlayStation 2 games play with the LRPS2 core - Clearer message when the add-on has no emulator for a platform v0.2.1 - New add-on icon v0.2.0 - Continue playing, backlog, and browsing by genre, region and play status - Favourite, backlog, play status and hide games from the context menu (pair again to allow favourites) - Sort order setting, screenshots, other versions of a game, richer game details - Save sync, play time and activity reporting through a background service - Fix: release years were wrong v0.1.0: initial release - pairing, browsing, download and launch
